Welcome to Scania

Our purpose is to drive the shift towards a sustainable transport system, creating a world of mobility that is better for business, society and the environment.

Scania Dynamic. So good it's hard to describe.

Explore the next generation of long-haul transport, combining advanced aerodynamics, premium cab comfort and intelligent safety systems. 

Discover Scania Dynamic

Meet the new generation Scania Touring

The Scania Touring is being updated for the road ahead, with new powertrain options, enhanced safety features and further developments across the coach. The new generation also brings updates to design, passenger comfort, luggage capacity and the driver environment. Visit the campaign page to discover what is new and explore the new generation Scania Touring in more detail.

Explore the new generation Scania Touring

Scania Irizar i6S Efficient PHEV wins Sustainable Bus Award 2027

The Scania Irizar i6S Efficient PHEV has won the Sustainable Bus Award 2027 in the Coach category. Combining electric driving with long-distance capability, this innovative plug-in hybrid coach helps operators reduce fuel consumption by up to 47 percent and emissions by up to 94 percent when combined with HVO. 

Read the press release

Five-star Euro NCAP safety ratings

Euro NCAP has awarded Scania’s G-series and R-series five stars in its haulage assessment, with a 96 percent score for crash avoidance. The results add to the five-star ratings already achieved by Scania’s L- and P-series. Explore the Euro NCAP results

G-series trucks

Scania’s G-cab, used in regional and long-haulage operations, was awarded five stars in independent consumer testing organisation Euro NCAP’s Safer Trucks programme, in the haulage segment.

 

G-series trucks

R-series trucks

Scania’s R-cab, developed for premium long-haulage operations, was awarded five stars in independent consumer testing organisation Euro NCAP’s European Safer Trucks programme, in the haulage segment. 

 

R-series trucks

P-series trucks

Scania’s P-cab for distribution, combining a high driving position with strong all-round visibility, has achieved the highest score in Euro NCAP’s “CitySafe” category, recognising features designed to prevent accidents in urban environments.

 

P-series trucks

L-series trucks

Scania’s L-cab for utility operations, combining superior visibility with easy entry and exit, has achieved five stars in Euro NCAP’s Safer Trucks programme for both the distribution and utility segments.

 

L series trucks

News

From frontrunner to scale: Lessons from Norway’s transport transition

Explore how Norway can scale its transport transition, from electric trucks and renewable fuels to charging infrastructure, investment and collaboration.

Scania Performance summary Q3

Scania delivered a resilient performance in the third quarter of 2026, with improved profitability compared with the same period last year.

Scania electric machine wins 2026 Top New Products award

Scania’s EM 505A industrial electric machine wins OEM Off-Highway’s 2026 Top New Products award in the Drivetrains category.

Four partners and one electrified transport route in Portugal

Discover how IKEA, KLOG, the Port of Leixões and Scania are increasing daily trips and reducing CO2 emissions by electrifying a route in Portugal.

Go to our newsroom

We drive real change

With over 50,000 employees in more than 100 countries,  Scania is a truly global player. At Scania you’ll be part of a company with over 130-year track record of innovation, as we continue on our ambitious journey to drive the shift towards sustainable transport.

Join the Scania team

Transport solutions

By combining smart transport solutions, technological innovation and partnerships, we’re working to make sustainable transport a reality.

Discover Scania’s transport solutions

Our commitments

Our decarbonisation targets commits us to reduce emissions and work towards limiting global warming.

Scania’s sustainability commitments

Road safety

Scania provides a wide range of safety solutions to protect drivers, passengers and fellow road users against the dangers of the road. 

Find out more about our safety solutions

Visit Scania in your country

Visit your market website for more detailed information and get in contact with your local sales person.
